title: Troll Code 🤡
description: A prank extension for VS Code with three modes: Legit (light jokes), Troll (annoying) and opt-in Hardcore (pure chaos). Never edits your files. Panic button: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+P.

title: Apex Cleaner
description: Format Apex code, remove blank lines, comment out System.debug statements (never inside catch blocks) and highlight them in red for Salesforce Apex.

title: RulealizeStudio.Avalonia
description: Open a rule set as what it means: change a value it states or what one of its lists holds, see what that did to what is legal, and say whether it is what you meant.

title: Swagger Lens
description: Swagger preview with local OpenAPI diffs, affected endpoints, shared schemas, and light/dark themes.
